name: Drop Jump
instructions: Stand on a box about 30 to 60 cm high with your toes at the edge.
Step off the box. Do not jump off it. Land on both feet at the same time.
As soon as your feet touch the floor, jump straight up as high and as fast as you can. Keep the time on the floor as short as possible.
Land softly on both feet with your knees and hips bent.
Step back onto the box and reset fully before the next repetition.
